Where the figures come from

They are the Fotocal app's: each entry is a serving set by the app, built from rows of public databases (USDA FoodData Central and CIQUAL 2025) added up gram by gram, or its reference figure where there is no recipe. App snapshot: commit 4e8f041 (2026-10-16). General information about food, not medical or dietary advice.
